title: 2.1 Places Around Me
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize and name six familiar places and use it for a non-person identity statement.
grammar_function: A place; It is a/an place. Action in a place (in the park).
prerequisite: Unit 1 identity nouns, singular is, and clear action sentences.
speaking_outcome: Repeat five place identities and one cumulative action-in-place sentence intelligibly.
